purpose: DISCOVERY CANDIDATES ONLY. Not approved training data until verified + license-audited.

candidates.name: MMLU
candidates.notes: 15.9k MC questions over 57 subjects. Card: MIT. aux_train split usable for training; test split is benchmark.

candidates.name: MMLU-Pro
candidates.notes: 12k harder 10-option questions. Designed as a benchmark => evaluation_only; no training split offered.

candidates.name: CommonsenseQA
candidates.notes: 12k 5-choice commonsense questions. Clean MCQ; train/validation/dev splits.

candidates.name: HellaSwag
candidates.notes: 70k context + 4 plausible continuations (1 correct). Trains context->choice selection directly.

candidates.name: TruthfulQA
candidates.notes: 817 adversarial questions. Primarily an evaluation set => evaluation_only.

candidates.name: TriviaQA
candidates.notes: 95k trivia QA pairs with evidence documents. Answer is short span => WSTU short-answer fit.

candidates.name: BoolQ
candidates.notes: Passage + question -> boolean. Perfect match for WSTU TRUE/FALSE / YES-NO outputs.

candidates.name: BIG-Bench
candidates.notes: 204-task benchmark. Originally an evaluation suite; task-level licensing varies. Discover component tasks individually.

candidates.name: BIG-Bench Hard (BBH)
candidates.notes: 23 hardest BIG-Bench tasks with CoT targets. Benchmark => evaluation_only; strong WSTU reasoning eval.

candidates.name: BIG-Bench Hard (Joschka port)
candidates.notes: Alternative BBH port (includes non-MC task types). Duplicate risk vs lukaemon/bbh.

candidates.name: Natural Questions
candidates.notes: 307k real Google-search questions with Wikipedia evidence and short answers. Very large; sample rather than ingest fully.
